experience.title: Software Development Intern
bullets: Contributed to the design and development of Runway, a business relationship management application, utilizing TypeScript, React, Vite, Express, and PostgreSQL.
Collaborated in small teams to refine features, continuously improving user experience through iterative peer feedback and testing.
Assisted in maintaining production and development infrastructure on Amazon Web Services, ensuring maintainability and reliability.

experience.title: Technician
bullets: Maintained a professional and polite manner while assisting customers online and on-call, assisting them to solve problems, upholding the company’s positive reputation in the community.
Worked with a small team of employees to properly diagnose multiple computers accurately, quote repair costs, and finish the repairs all within a timely manner.

involvement.title: Member
bullets: Collaborate on the development of high-powered rocket avionics by defining system requirements, evaluating design constraints, and outlining hardware integration and testing.
Develop embedded systems in C++ using STM32-family microcontrollers alongside STM libraries to measure environmental factors with sensors and collect, process, and interpret real-time flight data.
Research and evaluate microcontroller and sensor solutions for avionics applications, contributing to the design of reliable and efficient data acquisition and event management.

involvement.title: Jr. Technician
bullets: Support the setup and operation of audio and lighting systems for campus events, working with a team to load, transport, assemble, and configure equipment according to client requirements.
Assist with live event production and technical troubleshooting, monitoring equipment throughout events and completing teardown and equipment organization afterward.

involvement.title: Senior Tech Support Volunteer
bullets: Provided patient and clear technical support to seniors in the local community, helping diagnose and resolve technology issues.
Managed time by both educating seniors on relevant topics about technology while also solving their problems, all within a time frame that allows all who need it to be assisted.
